prompts.ally_phoenix_completion:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production game sprite sheet, not a character concept. The reference is the established helmeted top-down ally identity and exact costume to retain. Create ONE organized transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 8 equal rows (48 sprites), preferably 1536x2048 portrait. Each row is a full motion sequence with 6 evenly spaced chronological poses, left to right. Each sprite is comfortably inside its cell with generous transparent separation. Same 16-bit pixel-art game style, chunky crisp pixel clusters, dark outlines, tiny metallic highlights; no smooth painted gradients or blur. Camera fixed at a high top-down 3/4 overhead view, character facing EAST/right throughout, realistic sturdy proportions. Same character, same palette, same armor bulk, helmet size, limbs, rifle, and view in every frame. No character redesign. Aim for a stable pelvis location at cell center; actions can change body orientation naturally during rolls and falling. No scenery, walls, text, labels, frames, grid lines, or decorative backdrop. No blood or gore.
Rows:
1) THROW GRENADE: rifle slung, draw small oval grenade, arm draws back, arm forward at release, follow-through, recover rifle ready. Do not draw traveling detached grenade projectile, separate projectile exists.
2) ROLL INTO PRONE: lower center of gravity, shoulder tuck, side roll curled, uncoil low, plant forearms, finish belly down head east aiming rifle right.
3) ROLL TO STAND: crouch, shoulder tuck, side roll curled, foot plant, rise, stand with rifle east.
4) HIT THEN STUN: first three frames hit flinch recoil/recoil peak/recover crouch; last three frames helmet clutch, stunned kneel, stunned sway. No flashing VFX obscuring armor.
5) DEATH: upright impact, stagger, knees buckle, fall right side, settle, completely still downed body head right. Rifle remains adjacent or held.
6) REVIVE: same downed pose, move arm, brace on elbow, push to kneel, rise, standing ready. Not a separate rescuer or glowing effect.
7) POWERUP THEN ASSIST HEAL: first three reach for pickup/hold small luminous energy cell at chest/stow and ready; last three kneel with medkit/open medkit/extend bandage toward an unseen ally outside the cell. One character only.
8) DUCK TO PRONE THEN RECOVERY: first three stand low crouch/lower forearms/fully prone rifle east; last three prone/push up on knee/rise rifle ready.
No repeated identical poses; make roll, prone, injury and revive silhouettes very clearly readable. Keep helmet on. All 48 figures fully visible, weapon tips and boots not clipped. Preserve authentic transparent alpha.
IDENTITY: Phoenix, athletic male, black/charcoal armor with ember red panels, orange-gold trim and hot amber visor. Prominent small golden phoenix shoulder insignia. Match the reference, including full helmet, compact rifle, gold cuff trim, orange chest square. Do not add hair, face, wings, capes.

prompts.tank_wren_tracks:
Use case: identity-preserve. Animate modular tank track components from the reference image, keeping its grounded metallic 16-bit Overdrive pixel art. Wren FOUNDry heavy tank. Worn ivory side armor, graphite metal tread, thin oxide-red stripes, small amber-orange lamp.
The reference is the module design guide, NOT the output layout. Generate a new transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY 6 columns and 2 rows, 12 separate vertical tank tread pods. 1536x1024 landscape canvas. Row 1 is LEFT track pod animation frames 1-6, row 2 is RIGHT track pod animation frames 1-6. Overhead orthographic view, nose/up direction at TOP of every frame. Track pod only, NOT complete tanks: no hull, turret, weapons, captions, frames, scenery or shadows on the background.
Each row is a seamless forward-driving 6-phase tread loop. The metal shoe bars progress down along the visible central tread belt in six equal small increments across the row, wrapping continuously into the next shoe pitch on the final-to-first transition. Draw clear shifting seams/highlights between the metal shoe bars, but armor housings, colored side plate positions, lamp, bolts, silhouette, width and height MUST remain fixed across all six frames. No bobbing, changing perspective, turning, drifting or resizing, no added dirt particles.
The exposed dark tread belt occupies the central vertical lane. Row 1 outer colored side armor is on its LEFT side; row 2 outer colored side armor is on its RIGHT side, so these can flank the existing bare hull. Preserve the distinctive armor plate shapes of the reference. Each pod centered identically within its equal cell, fully visible with ample transparent margins. Crisp square pixel clusters, restricted palette, no soft painted look. Transparent alpha background.

prompts.ally_directional_fire:
Use case: identity-preserve. Generate ONE transparent 6-column by 4-row sprite animation sheet, 24 sprites. References show Phoenix (first image) and Hotwire (second image). Preserve their exact helmeted armor identity, proportions and pixel-art palette. No redesign. This is additional 16-bit overhead run-and-gun art for Bullets of Fury Overdrive, NOT portraits or a poster.
Fixed high top-down 3/4 game camera. Each sprite same scale, centered in a generous equal cell, no clipping, transparent background. Crisp pixel clusters, dark outlines, no soft painting. No scenery, labels, captions or grid.
Every row shows a six-frame STATIONARY RIFLE FIRING CYCLE: 1 ready aim, 2 first shot flash and small recoil, 3 recover aim, 4 second shot flash small recoil, 5 settle rifle, 6 ready aim matching first. Feet stay planted and character does not turn or walk.
Row 1: PHOENIX aiming NORTH, up the screen. Back of helmet and back armor visible. Rifle barrel clearly projects past head to TOP edge. No face/visor visible from this back view.
Row 2: PHOENIX aiming SOUTH, down the screen. Amber visor visible. Rifle barrel clearly projects DOWN in front of torso. Feet behind body at upper side.
Row 3: HOTWIRE aiming NORTH, up the screen. Back helmet with copper center stripe, cyan cable backpack visible. Rifle barrel clearly projects past head toward TOP. Do not accidentally draw a south-facing figure.
Row 4: HOTWIRE aiming SOUTH, down the screen. Cyan visor visible, copper armor, rifle barrel clearly projects DOWN in front of torso.
Phoenix black charcoal armor, ember red shoulder plates with small gold phoenix motif, orange-gold rim accents, amber visor. Hotwire charcoal armor, copper/orange shoulder caps and helmet center stripe, thin cyan visor and cyan harness cables. Keep gender/body proportions from references. Small muzzle flash at rifle tip only on frames 2 and 4. No detached bullets, no large effect obscuring the body. Exact 24 isolated sprites.
